title: Blackwater Swamp
palette: inky blue-black water, muted jade moss, aubergine shadows, pale sulfur-gold mist
scene: A haunting ancient blackwater swamp seen from the adventurer's eye level. A broad dry root-and-earth causeway begins at the bottom center, winds gently left around a pool, then passes between enormous leaning cypress trunks into pale gold mist. Black mirror water, hanging moss, jade ferns, and pale weathered standing stones. An expansive, beautifully designed navigable place, not a cramped corridor.
wall: flat dark peat-stained gray rock with small patches of jade moss
floor: flat damp umber mud with fine root fibers and scattered tiny pebbles
secondary: flat nearly black teal still-water ripples with restrained turquoise glints, no reflections of objects
detail: flat deeply furrowed gray cypress bark with muted green lichen
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. Palette: inky blue-black water, muted jade moss, aubergine shadows, pale sulfur-gold mist. Scene: A haunting ancient blackwater swamp seen from the adventurer's eye level. A broad dry root-and-earth causeway begins at the bottom center, winds gently left around a pool, then passes between enormous leaning cypress trunks into pale gold mist. Black mirror water, hanging moss, jade ferns, and pale weathered standing stones. An expansive, beautifully designed navigable place, not a cramped corridor.
atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat dark peat-stained gray rock with small patches of jade moss. TOP RIGHT: flat damp umber mud with fine root fibers and scattered tiny pebbles. BOTTOM LEFT: flat nearly black teal still-water ripples with restrained turquoise glints, no reflections of objects. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat deeply furrowed gray cypress bark with muted green lichen. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. Palette: inky blue-black water, muted jade moss, aubergine shadows, pale sulfur-gold mist. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
